FIELDS.NAME: Military Surplus Depot
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Manager, Military Surplus Depot, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: jdoe@militarysurplusdepot.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Military Surplus Depot specializes in the retail of high-quality military surplus goods, primarily sourced from domestic government auctions and reputable military surplus wholesalers. Our operations include the sale of a wide variety of items, including clothing, camping gear, tactical accessories, and survival equipment, ensuring full traceability of all products to comply with regulatory standards. We prioritize safety and security within our store, maintaining comprehensive fire and water protection systems, including alarms and sprinklers, to minimize property risks. Additionally, all staff undergo training in regulatory compliance and safe handling of military surplus goods to mitigate operational liabilities. We conduct regular inventory appraisals to maintain accurate valuation and ensure our offerings meet customer needs in a safe shopping environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
November 15, 2022: Water damage from an internal pipe leak; $1,500; Resolved with insurance claim.  
April 10, 2023: Theft of inventory during a break-in; $1,000; Claim in process with law enforcement.  
September 5, 2023: Damage to property due to a fire caused by faulty wiring; $5,000; Under investigation.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL Listed, Grade 1
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring, on-site security personnel during business hours, and regular physical security audits.
